text: My stepdaughter is 6. Temp is 37.6. Her hands and feet are like ice and she's shaking under two blankets even though she's meant to have a temperature, she says she's freezing. The other thing is she won't put her chin down. I asked her to look at her belly button and she just moved her eyes, kept her head dead straight and said it hurts at the back. She's completely with it though, chatting away and watching her programme, answers everything. Thought I'd ask before deciding what to do.
